title: Part 3 — Conversation 1: a late delivery
instructionsVi: Nghe hội thoại rồi trả lời 3 câu. Trong đề thật bạn có khoảng 8 giây đọc trước câu hỏi. Ba câu luôn theo thứ tự: đầu đoạn, giữa đoạn, rồi việc sắp làm.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 32 through 34.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Hi Marcus, do you have a second? It's about the Delaney order.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: The one going out today?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: It was meant to. The courier just called — their van broke down outside Reading and they can't collect until tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That's a problem. Delaney's shop opens on Friday and they need stock on the shelves by Thursday.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I know. If they collect at eight tomorrow it still arrives Thursday afternoon, but there's no margin at all.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Then let's not rely on it. I'll ring Delaney now and tell them what's happened before they hear it from the courier.

questions.prompt: 32. What is the problem?

options.text: A shop has cancelled its opening.
A courier's vehicle has broken down.
An order was sent to the wrong address.
A product is out of stock.

questions.explanationVi: 'their van broke down outside Reading'. Vấn đề nằm ở phía đơn vị vận chuyển, không phải ở hàng hoá.

questions.prompt: 33. Why is the delay serious?

options.text: The order will be cancelled automatically.
The warehouse closes tomorrow.
The customer's shop opens on Friday.
The courier will charge extra.

questions.explanationVi: 'Delaney's shop opens on Friday and they need stock on the shelves by Thursday'.

questions.prompt: 34. What will the man do next?

options.text: Book a different courier
Collect the order himself
Wait until Thursday afternoon
Telephone the customer

questions.explanationVi: 'I'll ring Delaney now'. Câu cuối của Part 3 gần như luôn hỏi hành động kế tiếp.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 2: booking a training room
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Đoạn này có một chỗ người nói tự sửa lại thông tin — nghe hụt là mất điểm.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 35 through 37.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Facilities, this is Ade.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Hi Ade. I need a room for a training session on the fourteenth, for about twenty people.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Twenty. The Boardroom takes eighteen, so that's out. Training Room A takes thirty — let me check the fourteenth. Sorry, I'm looking at the wrong month. The fourteenth… yes, it's free all day.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Great. Does it have a projector?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: It does, but the bulb is being replaced next week. I'd bring a laptop and use the large screen instead, just in case.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Fine. Can you put it in the calendar and send me the room code?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Will do. I'll email it this afternoon.

questions.prompt: 35. Why is the Boardroom unsuitable?

options.text: It is already booked on the fourteenth.
It does not have a projector.
It is being redecorated.
It holds fewer people than required.

questions.explanationVi: 'The Boardroom takes eighteen, so that's out' — cần chỗ cho hai mươi người. Phải so hai con số.

questions.prompt: 36. What does the man suggest about the projector?

options.text: That she book a different room
That she request a new bulb herself
That the woman bring a laptop and use the screen instead
That the session be postponed

questions.explanationVi: 'I'd bring a laptop and use the large screen instead, just in case' — vì bóng đèn máy chiếu sắp được thay.

questions.prompt: 37. What will the man send?

options.text: A projector bulb
The room code
A list of attendees
A quotation

questions.explanationVi: 'send me the room code' — 'I'll email it this afternoon'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 3: at a hotel reception
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Chú ý phân biệt điều khách YÊU CẦU với điều lễ tân thực sự ĐÁP ỨNG được.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 38 through 40.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Good afternoon. I have a reservation under Okafor, checking in today.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Let me see… yes, three nights, a standard room on the fourth floor.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'd asked for a quiet room away from the lift, if that's possible.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I can see the note. The fourth floor is fully booked, I'm afraid, but I can move you to the sixth — same room type, and it's at the far end of the corridor.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That works. One more thing: is breakfast included?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Not on this rate, but you can add it for twelve pounds a morning, and it's cheaper if you pay for all three nights now.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'll take all three then.

questions.prompt: 38. What had the man requested in advance?

options.text: A room on the fourth floor
A late check-out
Breakfast to be included
A room away from the lift

questions.explanationVi: 'I'd asked for a quiet room away from the lift'. Tầng bốn là phòng đã đặt sẵn, không phải yêu cầu của khách.

questions.prompt: 39. What does the woman offer to do?

options.text: Upgrade him to a larger room
Give him a discount on the room rate
Move him to the sixth floor
Extend his stay by one night

questions.explanationVi: 'I can move you to the sixth — same room type'. Bà ấy nói rõ CÙNG hạng phòng, nên (A) sai.

questions.prompt: 40. What does the man decide about breakfast?

options.text: It is already included in his rate.
He will pay for all three mornings now.
He will decide each morning.
He will eat elsewhere.

questions.explanationVi: 'it's cheaper if you pay for all three nights now' — 'I'll take all three then'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 4: three speakers, staffing a stand
format: TOEIC Listening — Part 3 · Conversation 4, ba người nói (câu 41–43)
instructionsVi: Hội thoại BA người. Câu hỏi thường hỏi ý kiến của một người cụ thể, nên phải theo dõi ai nói gì chứ không chỉ nhớ nội dung.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation among three speakers and answer questions 41 through 43.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: So, the trade fair stand. We need two people on it at all times, and it runs three days.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I can do Wednesday and Thursday, but not Friday — I've got the audit that morning.

transcript.speaker: W2
transcript.text: I'm free all three days. But I've never done a stand before, so I'd rather not be on it alone.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: You won't be. I'll take Friday with you. That leaves Wednesday and Thursday covered by you two.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Do we have the new brochures? Last year we ran out by lunchtime on day one.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: Five hundred ordered, arriving Monday. I'll bring them over myself so they don't sit in the post room.

questions.prompt: 41. Why can the man not work on Friday?

options.text: He has never worked on a stand.
He will be collecting brochures.
He is travelling that day.
He has an audit that morning.

questions.explanationVi: 'not Friday — I've got the audit that morning'. (A) là lo ngại của người phụ nữ thứ hai, không phải của ông ta.

questions.prompt: 42. What concern does the second woman raise?

options.text: She is unavailable on Wednesday.
She does not want to staff the stand alone.
She thinks five hundred brochures is too few.
She has another event that week.

questions.explanationVi: 'I've never done a stand before, so I'd rather not be on it alone'.

questions.prompt: 43. What will the first woman do with the brochures?

options.text: Order five hundred more
Leave them in the post room
Deliver them to the stand herself
Send them directly to the venue

questions.explanationVi: 'I'll bring them over myself so they don't sit in the post room'. (B) chính là điều bà ấy muốn TRÁNH.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 5: a job applicant calls
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có một chi tiết được nêu dưới dạng điều kiện — bỏ qua điều kiện là chọn sai dù nghe đúng con số.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 44 through 46.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Hello, Brightmoor Recruitment.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Hi, I applied for the warehouse supervisor post last week. I wanted to check whether you'd received my references.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Let me look. We have one from Hartley Logistics… but the second one hasn't come through.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That'll be from my previous manager. He's been on leave.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: That's fine — we can shortlist you with one reference, as long as the second arrives before the interview stage. Interviews are the week of the twentieth.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'll chase him today. Is there anything else outstanding?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Just the forklift certificate. Email a scan and I'll add it to your file.

questions.prompt: 44. Why is the man calling?

options.text: To check whether his references have arrived
To arrange an interview date
To withdraw his application
To ask about the salary

questions.explanationVi: 'I wanted to check whether you'd received my references'.

questions.prompt: 45. Under what condition can he be shortlisted with one reference?

options.text: If he provides a forklift certificate
If his former manager returns from leave
If he applies again after the twentieth
If the second reference arrives before the interview stage

questions.explanationVi: 'as long as the second arrives before the interview stage'. Đây là điều kiện, không phải lời hứa vô điều kiện.

questions.prompt: 46. What is the man asked to send?

options.text: A new application form
His manager's contact details
A scan of his forklift certificate
A copy of his identification

questions.explanationVi: 'Just the forklift certificate. Email a scan'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 6: returning a faulty item
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Câu hỏi thứ hai hỏi HÀM Ý của một câu nói, không hỏi nghĩa đen.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 47 through 49.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Hi, I bought this kettle here three weeks ago and it's stopped heating.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I've got the card statement, not the paper receipt.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Well, that's not ideal. But three weeks is inside our thirty-day window, and the statement shows the store and the amount, so I can look it up.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Would I get a refund or a replacement?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Either. Though I'd say we've had four of that model back this month, so I'd take the refund and choose something else.

questions.prompt: 47. What is the problem with the product?

options.text: It has stopped heating.
It arrived damaged.
It is the wrong model.
It was overpriced.

questions.explanationVi: 'I bought this kettle here three weeks ago and it's stopped heating'.

questions.prompt: 48. What does the man mean when he says, 'that's not ideal'?

options.text: The purchase is outside the return window.
A card statement is acceptable but less convenient than a receipt.
The kettle cannot be returned at all.
He does not believe the customer.

questions.explanationVi: Ngay sau đó ông ta nói 'But three weeks is inside our thirty-day window… so I can look it up'. Câu 'not ideal' chỉ là nói giảm, không phải từ chối.

questions.prompt: 49. What does the man recommend?

options.text: Taking a replacement of the same model
Waiting until the receipt is found
Contacting the manufacturer directly
Taking a refund and choosing a different product

questions.explanationVi: 'we've had four of that model back this month, so I'd take the refund and choose something else'.

title: Part 3 — Conversation 7: rearranging a site visit
instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có hai mốc thời gian được nhắc tới và một trong hai bị thay đổi — bám vào lượt nói cuối cùng.
promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 50 through 52.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Priya, are we still visiting the Kingsbury site on Tuesday?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: That was the plan, but the contractor asked to move it. They're pouring concrete Tuesday and the yard will be closed.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Wednesday, then?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Wednesday I'm in Manchester all day. Thursday morning would work — say ten o'clock.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Ten's fine. How long should I allow?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Two hours for the walk-round, plus travel. It's about forty minutes each way, so block out the whole morning.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'll update the calendar and let the contractor know.

questions.prompt: 50. Why was the original date changed?

options.text: Concrete is being poured and the yard will be closed.
The woman will be in Manchester.
The contractor has cancelled the project.
The man is unavailable on Tuesday.

questions.explanationVi: 'They're pouring concrete Tuesday and the yard will be closed'. (B) là lý do loại thứ Tư, không phải thứ Ba — bẫy ghép sai lý do với ngày.

questions.prompt: 51. When will the visit take place?

options.text: Tuesday at ten
Wednesday morning
Thursday at ten
Thursday afternoon

questions.explanationVi: 'Thursday morning would work — say ten o'clock'.

questions.prompt: 52. How much time does the woman advise setting aside?

options.text: Two hours in total
The whole morning
Forty minutes
The whole day

questions.explanationVi: Hai tiếng đi bộ khảo sát cộng bốn mươi phút mỗi chiều, nên bà ấy kết luận 'block out the whole morning'.
